name: Upholstered wooden furniture, kitchen cabinets, and vanities subject to 25% Section 232 duty (Proclamation 10976, effective October 14, 2025)
notes: HTSUS 9903.76.02: 25% on upholstered wooden furniture (couches, sofas, chairs). Applies to all countries EXCEPT UK (10%), EU (15%), Japan (15%).
HTSUS 9903.76.03: 25% on completed kitchen cabinets, vanities, and parts thereof. Applies to all countries EXCEPT UK (10%), EU (15%), Japan (15%).
Rate was originally scheduled to increase to 30% (furniture) and 50% (cabinets) on January 1, 2026; DEFERRED to January 1, 2027 by the December 31, 2025 amendment proclamation.

9903.76.04 carve-out: articles classified under the cabinet subheadings that are OTHER THAN completed wooden kitchen cabinets/vanities or parts thereof are NOT subject to this duty. The model applies this rate to the full 10-digit subheadings below as a conservative approximation.
Products subject to this proclamation are NOT subject to Section 122 surcharge (Section 232 stacking rule).
African countries with notable exposure: South Africa, Morocco, Egypt (wooden furniture and cabinetry exporters).
